The '''liberation of 400100500260026''' occurred in the year [[3946 BBY]], in response to the [[Secession of 400100500260026|secession]] of a number of [[Planet/Legends|planets]], under the control of [[G0-T0 infrastructure planning system|G0-T0]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]], from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The droids succession managed to effectively cut off [[400100500260026]] from [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] communication with the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and also managed to block all forms of traffic in and out of swath of territory in [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]]. Not long after the secession, the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tol Cressa]] was able to organize a successful recapture of the planets which had been under control of the rogue G0-T0 droids.
